description: RepoQA style (Python): find a function in a synthetic sixty-file project from a behavioural description alone, with no name given. The project holds near-miss decoys (calendar days, weekdays of a month, billable days that include weekends, an inclusive-end leave counter, a date shifter, a weekend counter), so the answer is only right when the half-open range, weekend skipping and closed-date handling are all checked. Read-only; the answer must be given as path::function.
